digest.component_or_area: LLM configuration and model class resolution
propositions: LLM model selection is inferred from equality tests against framework defaults rather than explicitly configured, causing verifier downgrades to silently stop applying across multiple code paths
A single scalar REBAR_LLM_MODEL cannot express per-tier model mappings needed for different capability classes across multiple gate passes

REBAR_LLM_CONFIG_FILE pointer must perform deep recursive merging on table values and wholesale array replacement to allow overriding individual class attributes without restating entire config sections

The three reserved model class names (trivial, standard, frontier) must resolve through a single function at three distinct call sites: config.resolve_model, model_ladder expansion, and verifier path resolution
Class-to-model resolution cannot occur at YAML load time because class mappings depend on process-scoped environment and CLI layers that are not available until runtime
Deep config merging must be implemented in the LLM resolver and not in the shared read_reserved_section helper to avoid altering layering behavior for unrelated config consumers
